first_summary: The catalog was written on the Haiku-4.5/Opus-5 landscape. Its 1x/2x/4-5x cost ladder, "Haiku accepts no effort", "200K hard wall" (which also justifies the ToolSearch omission and the 400K selection-table row), and "no `effort` parameter on the Agent tool / only two places" claims are all contradicted by the 2.1.295 facts, and the "26% cheaper" figure rests on a retired Sonnet 5 effort index. The pins (sonnet/high inspector, inherit/high reviewer, opus/xhigh judge), the "roughly half on Opus 5.5" arithmetic, the "frontmatter `max` unverified" caveat and model-scoped caches are confirmed and must survive the rewrite. Line 62 has a copy-paste bug: the builder section carries mechanical's Tools bullet.
critic_summary: The first pass was thorough on cost, Haiku context and Haiku effort, but it missed the Agent tool's parameter list at L9-10, the 'only way to vary effort per call' repetition at L16, the general-purpose 'bypasses effort' claim at L185, and the 'output cost is the number to reason with' framing at L3. It also left several still-true-keep rows unrecorded, and I dispute none of its findings.
